cam_limitations: Predicted-logit gradient map at coarse 7x7; localization is diagnostic, not causal/pathology proof. Border heat is interpreted relative to region area.
augmentation_findings: Actual flips/affines preserve visible major lesions/colours across these 33 examples. Mild edge clipping and white wedges occur; backgrounds/fingers remain. No strong brightness/color modifications; no exhaustive lesion-mask retention guarantee.
preprocessing_findings: Full oriented frame retained with one shared resize/normalization; raw source black/gray backgrounds are preserved, not newly removed. Tiny lesion detail can soften at224 pixels.
source_findings: PlantVillage-overlap579:570correct98.45%; Corn-only48:37correct77.08%; Corn-only GLS2/9recall22.22%. Overlapping archives, small subgroup/noHealthy, no verified independent field/plant domains.
conclusion: Suitable for a limited FYP research inference prototype with disclosed source/class/confidence weaknesses; field/commercial validity unestablished. These observations do not justify a particular class weight, random hyperparameter search or larger architecture. New plant/session-independent field data and verified labels are the scientific next validation step.
